reduced.refused: <project>/node_modules/expo/Expo.podspec: `s.compiler_flags = compiler_flags` cannot be evaluated: it uses `compiler_flags`, which is assigned `get_folly_config()[:compiler_flags]`, which the reader cannot evaluate (the method call `get_folly_config(...)`). The podspec reader evaluates locals, string interpolation, arrays, ENV['...'], package.json reads, comparisons, ternaries and if/unless blocks; building from the part it could read would leave some of the library's files or settings out of its target. Install Ruby (sudo apt install ruby) so rn-xtool reads the podspec as CocoaPods does, or give the library a Package.swift of its own.
